v1.4.0e (13 October 2022) |feed_title = Badlands 2.0! |previous_update = [[v1.3.2]] |next_update = [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022 Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.4.0''' is the forty-third update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 30th of September 2022. This update is notable for adding the [[Badlands II]] to the game. This update was also given the name '''Wanted Dead Update'''. This version encompassed six updates, the main v1.4.0 update (released 30 September 2022) and five minor updates, the v1.4.0a (released 1 October 2022), v1.4.0b (released 4 October 2022), v1.4.0c (released 9 October 2022), v1.4.0d (released 13 October 2022) and v1.4.0e (released 13 October 2022). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== :Multiple enemies were added as part of the [[Badlands II]] map. *[[Breaker]] *[[Breaker2]] *[[Breaker3]] *[[Breaker4]] *[[Husk]] *[[Undead Miner]] *[[Cavalry]] *[[Gunslinger]] ===Maps=== *[[Badlands II]] (Survival, Special) ===Crates=== *New skin for the [[Premium Crate]] **Skin: ***[[Cowboy]]: {{Color|Premium|Cop}} *New skins for the [[Deluxe Crate]] **Skins: ***[[Cowboy]]: {{Color|Deluxe|Cyberpunk}}, {{Color|Deluxe|Retired}}, {{Color|Deluxe|Noir}} ===Seasons=== *[[Philips x TDS Season#Season Pass|Philips x TDS Season]] **Rewards: ***Rank 1 - {{Color|Philips|Intern}} [[Scout]] & [[Golden Scout]] ***Rank 2 - {{Color|Philips|Grand Theft}} [[Soldier]] & [[Golden Soldier]] ***Rank 3 - {{Color|Philips|Lumberjack}} [[Militant]] ***Rank 4 - {{Color|Philips|Agent}} [[Cowboy]] & [[Golden Cowboy]] ***Rank 5 - Unknown {{Color|Philips|Skin}} ***Rank 6 - Unknown {{Color|Philips|Skin}} ***Rank 7 - Unknown {{Color|Philips|Skin}} ***Rank 8 - Unknown {{Color|Philips|Skin}} ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Gift Box]] Menu *[[Cowboy]] [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] *[[Badges|Quickdraw!]] and [[Badges|Defeated Gunslinger!]] badges **[[Badges|Defeated Gunslinger!]] badge gives the [[Cowboy]] **[[Badges|Quickdraw!]] badge gives the {{Color|Other|Badlands}} [[Cowboy]] *[[Matchmaking]] Beta Testing **Can be accessed through three statues: ***[[Minigunner]] statue, creates a match in a random map (represents survival) ***[[Nuclear Monster]] statue, creates a match in the [[Polluted Wasteland II]] map ***[[Gunslinger]] statue, creates a match in the [[Badlands II]] map *[[Badlands (Modifier)|Badlands]] modifier *[[All Paths]] modifier *Razors currency *{{Color|Other|Foam}} [[Freezer]] obtained by purchasing a [[NERF: The Mint Choco Freezer Dart Blaster]] *{{Color|Other|Prime Raven}} [[Scout]] obtained from the Amazon Prime Gaming subscription ==Removals== *[[Badlands]] *[[End of Summer Season]] **All unclaimed rewards can be claimed in the [[Gift Box]] menu ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]]'s all skin Level 0-5 appearance changed. *[[Cowboy]] reworked. **'''Cowboy''' can no longer be obtained from [[Badlands]] as it was removed. Now it can only be obtained from [[Badlands II]]. **No longer gives a random amount of cash, now gives a set amount of cash. **Amount of cash generated no longer increases with each wave, now increases with Levels. **Now shows the amount of shots needed for it to generate cash. **Now spins its guns when generating cash, which prevents it from attacking. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|650}} to {{Money|550}}. ****Damage decreased from 3 to 2. ****Firerate decreased from 1.525 to 1.025. ****Cash Shot of 6 added. ****Spin Time of 1.7 added. ****Generates {{Money|25}} instead of a random amount which increases with each wave. ***'''Level 1''' ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|1.525 > 1.325|-0.2}} to {{Tooltip|1.025 > 0.825|-0.2}}. ****Renamed from ''Quick Shot'' to ''Steady Hand''. ***'''Level 2''' ****Damage increased from +0 to +2. ****Range increased from +0 to +2. ****Cash shot increased from 5 to 6. ****Income now changes from {{Money|25}} > {{Money|50}}. ****Renamed from ''Gold Shot'' to ''Lucky Shot''. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|1,250}} to {{Money|1,650}}. ****Firerate changed from 1.325 to {{Tooltip|0.825 > 0.625|-0.2}}. ****Spin Time now changes from 1.7 > 1.3. ****Renamed from ''Dualling Instincts'' to ''Faster Instincts''. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|4,250}} to {{Money|4,000}}. ****Damage increased from +0 to +2. ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|1.325 > 0.675|-0.65}} to {{Tooltip|0.625 > 0.375|-0.25}}. ****Income now changes from {{Money|50}} >
